## What changed

Describe the paper, correction, or new topic and why it belongs here.

## Primary sources

Link sources supporting the title, date, venue, resource availability, and summary.

## Checklist

- [ ] Updated both English and Chinese READMEs, or explained the missing translation.
- [ ] Kept tables at five columns and entries ordered by first release.
- [ ] Verified official links and stated partial releases accurately.
- [ ] Updated counts, contents links, and source notes where needed.
- [ ] Previewed the changed Markdown.
